script.title: SUMMER CAMP SIGN-UP
script.scene_zh: 夏令營報名台 · 搶名額
script.story_hook: A dad signs his kid up before spots run out.
script.intro_zh: 爸爸趕在最後幾個名額額滿前，幫孩子報名夏令營。
script.welcome_en: Hello again, summer dreamers! Today we're signing up for summer camp.
script.welcome_zh: 大家好，愛夏天的朋友們！今天我們要報名夏令營。
script.outro: Spot secured, gear listed, buddy noted. Summer looks great.
script.outro_zh: 名額到手、裝備列好、好友也註記了，夏天穩了。
script.practice_intro_en: One more round: listen, then repeat.
script.practice_intro_zh: 再來一輪：先聆聽，再跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a sporty dad in his mid forties with a shaved head and a sunburned nose, wearing a heather gray running jacket and a digital watch, tapping his phone as he reads the camp flyer
script.char_b_description: a sunny camp counselor in her early twenties with bright coral braids tied back, wearing an olive scout vest covered in small patches, holding a clipboard and a yellow marker
script.youtube_title: 【🏕️夏令營報名英文】「幫你先留一個名額嗎？」🌊名額、泳具、好友同組一次搞定｜🎧A2 聽力練習｜Summer Camp
script.youtube_title_en: “Want Me to Hold One?” — Signing Up for Summer Camp
script.youtube_description:
夏令營名額快要額滿，用英文報名要問什麼？這段爸媽與營位顧問的對話，教你確認週次名額、留位子、問泳具清單與好友同組。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Summer camp spots fill up fast, and asking in English can feel stressful. This signup-desk conversation helps: a dad checks which week is available, asks the counselor to hold a spot, learns the swim gear list, and gets two friends placed together. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a listen-and-repeat section.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🏕️夏令營報名英文｜確認週次・留名額・泳具清單｜聽完就會報夏令營｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
夏令營將額滿，用英文報名時該問哪些？
泳裝裝備、同組好友，怎麼請顧問一起處理？

這一集帶大家走進夏令營報名台，跟著一位爸爸從確認七月的週次名額、請顧問留位，到記下泳具清單與好友同組的註記，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
⛺ 確認與留位：例如「Which week are you looking at?」、「Want me to hold one?」。
🏊 泳具清單：例如「What gear should we pack?」、「Goggles, a cap, and a towel, please.」。
👫 好友同組：例如「Can she request a buddy in her group?」、「I'll note them together.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

這個夏天，幫孩子把營位報好報滿！
script.thumbnail_action: checking a spot on the camp schedule board

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning! I'd like to sign my kid up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ aɪd laɪk tə saɪn maɪ kɪd ʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great! Which week are you looking at?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt wɪtʃ wiːk ɑr ju ˈlʊkɪŋ æt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, the second week of July, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ðə ˈsɛkənd wiːk əv dʒuˈlaɪ aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 呃，我想是七月的第二週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 老實說，那一週幾乎額滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no. Are any spots left?
dialogue.zh: 喔不，還有剩下的名額嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two, actually. Want me to hold one?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈæktʃuəli wɑnt mi tə hoʊld wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 其實還有兩個，要我先幫你留住一個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please! Her name's Nora, she's eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliːz hɜr nɛmz ˈnɔrə ʃiz eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！她叫 Nora，今年八歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does she need the swim session too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ʃi nid ðə swɪm ˈsɛʃən tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She does. What gear should we pack?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi dʌz wʌt ɡɪr ʃʊd wi pæk/
dialogue.zh: 要。我們該幫她帶哪些裝備？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Goggles, a cap, and a towel, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɑɡəlz ə kæp ænd ə ˈtaʊəl pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 請準備泳鏡、泳帽和一條毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can she request a buddy in her group?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ʃi rɪˈkwɛst ə ˈbʌdi ɪn hɜr ɡrup/
dialogue.zh: 她可以要求跟好朋友同一組嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, write the friend's name on the form.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr raɪt ðə frɛndz neɪm ɑn ðə fɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 可以，把好友的名字寫在表上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her friend Mia is coming too, luckily.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr frɛnd ˈmi.a ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ tu ˈlʌkɪli/
dialogue.zh: 幸運的是，她好朋友 Mia 也來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even better, I'll note them together.
dialogue.zh: 那就更好了，我會把她們註記同組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When is payment due for the week?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn ɪz ˈpeɪmənt du fɔr ðə wiːk/
dialogue.zh: 這一週的費用什麼時候要繳？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By June twentieth, online or at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ dʒun ˈtwɛntiəθ ˈɑnˌlaɪ ɔr æt ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 六月二十日前，線上或到現場繳都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's easy. Thanks for holding the spot!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈizi θæŋks fɔr ˈhoʊldɪŋ ðə spɑt/
dialogue.zh: 很簡單。謝謝你幫我們留名額！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure! See you on day one.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈplɛʒər si ju ɑn deɪ wʌn/
